cards.snippet: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

cards.card_text: True or false: The psalmist says the deceitfulness of those who stray from God's statutes is in vain.
cards.verse_text: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
cards.snippet: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

cards.card_text: Then he asks the LORD to make His face shine upon His servant, and to "teach me Your statutes." He wants the WHOLE recipe, baker, down to the last pinch of sprinkles.
cards.verse_text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
cards.snippet: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.

cards.card_text: I will obey Your statutes."
cards.verse_text: I will obey Your statutes.

cards.card_text: The writer says salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek God's statutes.
cards.verse_text: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
cards.snippet: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.

cards.card_text: The writer says his lips pour forth praise because God teaches him His statutes.
cards.verse_text: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
cards.snippet: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.

cards.card_text: Now the psalm says God declares His word, His statutes and judgments, to a people.
cards.verse_text: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
cards.snippet: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.

cards.card_text: He says her people have rejected His ordinances and have not walked in His statutes.
cards.verse_text: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her.
cards.snippet: …rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her.

cards.card_text: God gives His reason: these men haven't followed His statutes or practiced His ordinances.
cards.verse_text: For you have neither followed My statutes nor practiced My ordinances, but you have conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.”

cards.snippet: He follows My statutes and faithfully keeps My ordinances.

cards.card_text: Suppose a wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all God's statutes and does what is just and right.
cards.verse_text: But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

cards.card_text: He tells them not to walk in the statutes of their fathers or defile themselves with their fathers' idols.

cards.card_text: God tells the children not to walk in their fathers' statutes.
cards.verse_text: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.
cards.snippet: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them.

cards.card_text: True or false: the children walk in His statutes and carefully keep His ordinances.
cards.verse_text: They did not walk in My statutes or carefully observe My ordinances—though the man who does these things will live by them—and they profaned My Sabbaths.

cards.card_text: God says He gave them over to statutes that were not good, and pronounced them unclean through their gifts: the sacrifice of every firstborn in the fire.
cards.verse_text: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.
cards.snippet: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and ordinances by which they could not live.

cards.card_text: God says His servant will be king over them, one shepherd for all of them, and they will follow His ordinances and keep His statutes.
cards.verse_text: They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.
cards.snippet: They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.

cards.card_text: Then the Lord GOD gives the statutes for the altar's first days, served by the Levitical priests from the family of Zadok, a priest in King David's day (2 Samuel 8:17): seven days of sin offerings and burnt offerings, blood on the altar's horns and salt on the burnt offerings, until the altar is cleansed and consecrated.
cards.verse_text: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be splattered on it: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.

cards.card_text: The LORD's charge against Judah is that they reject the ___ of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes.
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
cards.snippet: …they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.

cards.card_text: What has the city done with the statutes of Omri and the practices of Ahab's house?
cards.verse_text: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel.

cards.card_text: Those are the statutes and ordinances He commanded Moses at Horeb, the mountain of God (Exodus 3:1).
cards.verse_text: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
